title: Hotline MCP servers configuration (v1)
description: Stdio MCP server definitions in mcp.json (unit: JSON object).

version.description: Optional MCP config schema version; absent means 1 (unit: integer).

mcpServers.description: Stdio MCP servers keyed by server name (unit: server map).

command.description: Executable name or path to launch the MCP server (unit: command string).

args.description: Command-line arguments passed to the server (unit: argument array).

env.description: Environment variables; '${hotline:secret:<name>}' resolves from Credential Locker (unit: env var map).

cwd.description: Working directory for the server process (unit: directory path).
